description: KEYTRUDA, in combination with paclitaxel, with or without bevacizumab, is indicated for the treatment of platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma in adults whose tumours express PD-L1 with a CPS >= 1 and who have received one or two prior systemic treatment regimens.
